text: You're likely referring to the context of the war. Unfortunately, there are multiple wars throughout history, so I will need more information to pinpoint the exact war you're asking about. Some notable conflicts include World War I (1914-1918), World War II (1939-1945), and the War of the Roses (1455-1485). If you could provide more context or specify the war you're interested in, I'd be happy to help you with the duration and conclusion of that conflict.
